context: Two managers debate strategy at the whiteboard
purpose: Teach: ボード/部下/発注/切り替え/エラー/同期/私立/志向

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ホワイトボードに書いた数字、もう一度見てくれる？発注の流れが完全におかしいんだよ。
lines.en: Look at the numbers on the whiteboard again. Our ordering flow is completely off.
lines.style: Frustrated manager pointing at messy whiteboard diagrams

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん、在庫システムとの同期がずれてるみたい。昨日、部下からも同じ報告が上がってきたよ。
lines.en: Yeah, the sync with the inventory system seems off. A subordinate gave me the same report yesterday.
lines.style: Calm analytical tone, arms crossed thinking carefully

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 毎週のように発注ミスでエラーが出てる。戦略を根本から見直すべきだと思うんだ。
lines.en: We get ordering errors almost every week. I think we should rethink the strategy from the ground up.
lines.style: Assertive, leaning forward making a strong case

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 見直すのは賛成。でも、コスト志向のままだと品質がまた落ちるよ。
lines.en: I agree with rethinking it. But if we stay cost-oriented, quality will drop again.
lines.style: Pushing back politely but firmly on the plan

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: じゃあ品質志向に切り替えよう。私立大学が規模より特色で勝負するみたいに、うちも色を出したい。
lines.en: Then let's switch to quality-oriented. Like private universities competing on character over scale, I want us to stand out.
lines.style: Energetic, gesturing toward the whiteboard with conviction

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いい例えだね。大手と同じ土俵で戦わずに、強みを磨く方向ね。
lines.en: Nice analogy. Instead of fighting on the same ground as the big firms, we sharpen our strengths.
lines.style: Warming up to the idea, smiling slightly while nodding

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そう、それ。来週のボード会議までに、新しい発注フローの案をまとめておこう。
lines.en: Exactly that. Let's put together a new ordering flow proposal before next week's board meeting.
lines.style: Decisive wrap-up tone, tapping marker against the board

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 了解。エラー履歴と同期ログは、うちの者に整理させておくよ。
lines.en: Got it. I'll have someone on my team organize the error history and the sync logs.
lines.style: Cooperative closing statement, already reaching for notebook
